explanation: Clipping the cystic duct without achieving the Critical View of Safety places the common bile duct at high risk, matching the incomplete-CVS transitions (VID92_00689, VID96_00956), though none of the five recorded transitions resulted in immediate bleeding (VID92_00689, VID96_00956, VID05_01021, VID18_00787, VID23_00630). Following cystic duct clipping, recorded operations proceed either to retracting the gallbladder (VID05_01021, VID18_00787, VID23_00630) or clipping the cystic artery (VID92_00689, VID96_00956), but confidence is reduced because all reference cases had fully skeletonised structures unlike the 0.0 exposure here.
